summary: Glacier National Park lookout near Many Glacier Hotel: a wooden platform tower marked gone; 1935 park photos were taken at the site; no source describes it today.

facts.status_note: Marked gone on firelookout.com; no source describes what remains on the ridge.

events.note: Page headline reads R.I.P. 1934-1937; the page does not say whether these years mark build or removal

notes_for_editor: Record kind is 'unknown'; firelookout.com calls the structure a wooden platform tower, so a human may want kind set to tower (not filed as a correction, since unknown is not an error). The R.I.P. 1934-1937 headline is kept as a range, not read as build and removal dates. The picryl copy of the 1935 panorama returned HTTP 403, so the 1935 photos rest on the NPS table alone. The Numa Ridge nomination concerns a different lookout and is used only for network context. No source describes what remains on the ridge today.
